supersedes_note: Both V2 path_memory_ablation runs (2026-03-08 FAIL and 2026-03-16 PASS) operated on a substrate without HippocampalModule (SD-004). This V3 run uses full SD-004/SD-005/SD-006 implementation and is the authoritative evidence for ARC-007.
evidence_direction_note: INVALIDATED 2026-07-22 by the action-object round-trip selection defect (ree-v3/CLAUDE.md, 'Action-object round trip is NOT an action source'): the driver selected each step as argmax(agent.hippocampal.action_object_decoder(traj.get_action_object_sequence()[:, 0, :])), which is arithmetically a CONSTANT on this substrate (E2's action_object head is an untrained frozen re-encoding; its outputs sit ~28x inside the decoder's input domain and move the logits by std 0.007-0.017 against per-class-mean gaps up to 0.33, so argmax pins to one class). The treatment arm's action stream is therefore INVARIANT under every manipulation of the candidate set or its scores -- an arithmetically forced no-op, not a policy. The published '99.2% harm reduction' is reproducible with a ZERO AGENT: the constant action stream walks into a wall, the episode never terminates, and the per-step harm-rate denominator inflates ~14x (20000 steps vs 1420 in the ablated arm). This was ARC-007's sole remaining behavioural support. Replacement: V3-EXQ-114a. [prior evidence_direction was 'supports' with no note]
